caption: The video captures a tranquil, narrow river flanked on both sides by dense, sunlit green trees and shrubs beneath a pale sky. The calm water fills the lower half of the scene and mirrors the foliage and a bright sky patch. A small dark rock protrudes at left of center, and a faint band of ripples marks the narrowing channel in the middle distance. The water surface keeps shimmering with low-amplitude ripples that subtly reshape the sky and tree reflections. The bright central reflection patch and the flow band vary slightly in brightness and edge detail as the surface moves. Two lens-flare artifacts persist in the upper and mid left, while the tree line, rock, and overall view appear fixed with no visible pan or zoom. No object is seen entering or exiting, and this gentle motion continues steadily.
relations: Calm water surface supports low-amplitude ripples that continuously distort sky and tree reflections.
Bright central reflection patch and mid-distance flow band fluctuate slightly as the water surface moves.
Fixed lens-flare artifacts persist in the upper and mid-left frame while the underlying water motion continues.
Surrounding dense tree line, protruding rock, and overall camera view remain stationary throughout the gentle surface motion.
